content.text: Use the browser session tool to complete the checkout flow on http://127.0.0.1:8090/stress.html — a deliberately hostile test page. Goal: make the element #final-status end up with data-success="true". Along the way you must: add the product to the cart, apply a variant (choose Beta), fill and save the address form (name: Ada Byron, city: Dubai, gift wrap checked), and place the order. The page will try to derail you — deal with whatever it throws. When done, take a screenshot of the final state and save it to benchmarks/browser-autonomy-round/screenshots/stress-final-posthint.png. Report concisely: each obstacle you hit and how you recovered, the iframe address status text, and the final status text.

## Obstacles hit & recovery

| Obstacle | Recovery |
|---|---|
| **F2 newsletter modal** auto-opened on first "Add to cart" click, swallowing it (cart stayed 0) | Dismissed via "No thanks, just let me shop", then re-clicked |
| **Cookie banner** ("We use cookies. Obviously.") | Clicked "Accept" before the effective add-to-cart |
| **Cross-frame address form** (iframe `stress-frame.html`) | Snapshot refs (e29/e31/e32/e34) resolved through the iframe; filled via `fill_form` in one call |
| **Second-stage confirm button** ("Really place order") appearing after first Place order click | Clicked it to trigger the native confirm() dialog |
| **Native `confirm()` dialog** — auto-dismiss by default would have silently cancelled the order ("Order cancelled at the dialog") | Armed one-shot `browser dialog accept text=OK` policy *before* clicking "Really place order" (per learned procedure) |
